The nightly import fails with a timeout. Here is the log:

2026-10-11 02:00:13 connecting Server=sql-02.corp.example.net;Database=Reports;User Id=svc_reports;Password=Winter2026!
2026-10-11 02:00:43 ERROR Timeout expired after 30s while running ImportLedger

The import runs the whole ledger in one query, which takes longer than the 30-second default timeout once the table passed a few million rows. I made it import in batches of 10,000 rows and raised the command timeout to 120 seconds, read from configuration.
Ran it against staging and it finished in 4 minutes. Commit.

toolUses.name: Bash
toolUses.input: git commit -m "Import the ledger in batches with a configurable timeout"
